messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@zenhealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 & security follow-up (ZenHealth)

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned on next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key goals you shared:
- Move to a production LLM inference provider for customer-facing features in H2 2026.
- Maintain SOC 2 compliance posture and provide evidence for audit and procurement teams.
- Ensure audit logs, data retention, and encryption/KMS meet your policies.

Main pain points discussed:
- Need up-to-date SOC 2 report (Type II) and scope details (what the report covers).
- Audit log access: your security team needs a way to retrieve request/response metadata and per-tenant logs for investigations.
- Data retention: requirements to retain logs for 1 year and ability to set shorter retention for dev/test.
- DPA & liability terms: your legal team has specific redlines on data processing and subprocessors.
- Pen test evidence & third-party scan results for our runtime and control environment.

What Redwood can provide (we covered briefly on call):
- Snapshot of our latest SOC 2 Type II report and a SOC 2 mapping spreadsheet that shows controls to product features.
- Audit log API and an export workflow (we can do S3 exports or direct access for auditors).
- Configurable retention windows per-tenant and account-level controls.
- Draft DPA (we can start with our standard and iterate with your legal).
- Pen test summary and redacted vulnerability reports; full artifacts provided under NDA / auditor access.

Agreed-next-steps:
1) I’ll share the SOC 2 summary + mapping sheet and a DPA draft (attached).
2) Alice / Tom: share your security questionnaire and any required artifact checklist so we can validate coverage.
3) Schedule a 60-min security deep-dive with your engineering + our security/product teams next week — please propose two time slots.
4) If needed, we can set up a temporary auditor access flow for Sigma Audit or your auditor.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, SOC2_mapping_sheet.xlsx, DPA_Redwood_v1.docx (attached)

If helpful, I can also create a short mutual action plan in HubSpot and share the timeline there.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 & security follow-up (ZenHealth)

Thanks Marissa — this is exactly what we need. A few clarifications and next items from our side: 

Clarifications:
- SOC 2 scope: we need to confirm whether the Type II covers both the hosted API and any managed/dedicated deployments (we're primarily evaluating hosted but need assurance for hybrid).
- Pen test evidence: redacted reports should be fine for initial review; we will request full artifacts under NDA if there are any open items.
- Audit logs: for initial procurement we need 6 months of retention by default and the ability to export longer windows for investigations.

What we’re sending back to you today:
- Our completed security questionnaire (attached) — please fill in controls where applicable and point us to artifacts.
- A short list of additional artifact requests: encryption in transit and at rest details, KMS provider, subprocessor list, incident response SLAs.

Timing: we’re aiming to complete vendor evaluation by mid-May to include in our FY H2 roadmap. A security deep-dive next week is ideal — we can do Mon 03/02 10:00am PT or Wed 03/04 2:00pm PT.

I’ve attached the ZenHealth_Security_Questionnaire.pdf. For the DPA, our legal prefers to start with your draft and then send redlines.

Thanks —
Alice Zhang
CISO | ZenHealth
